def translation_violations(grid, dr, dc):
    """Cells of grid that differ from their (dr, dc)-predecessor (out-of-range preds skipped)."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)

    """Translation (dr, dc) with the fewest periodicity violations (nonzero, non-degenerate)."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for dr in range(h):
